notes: The int8 transformer with the 4-bit-weight / 8-bit-activation text encoder (6.31 GB) instead of the int8 one, which is the only 4-bit file published for this model. bits is 4 for the text encoder's weights; the transformer in this pairing is still int8, so the id names what changed rather than the whole configuration. Worth measuring precisely because the text encoder is the larger of the two components: if prompt adherence survives it, it is the cheapest 3 GB available.
